# Reader-writer locks

A value many threads may read at once, or one may write.

<h2 id="rw-lock"><code>RwLock&lt;T&gt;</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct RwLock<T> {
    // private fields
}
```

A value guarded by a lock that many readers or one writer may hold, shared between the threads that hold a handle.
[`Clone`](/docs/api/sync/rw-lock#clone) gives another handle to the same value. The value is destroyed when the last handle and the last guard are
gone. A handle is not copied.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Sync/Src/RwLock.rux#L25)

| `T`  | the type of the guarded value |

<h3 id="read"><code>Read</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Read(&self) -> ReadGuard<T>
```

Takes a shared hold, waiting while a writer holds the lock.

**Returns**: the read guard

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Sync/Src/RwLock.rux#L67)

<h3 id="write"><code>Write</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Write(&self) -> WriteGuard<T>
```

Takes the exclusive hold, waiting while any reader or writer holds the lock.

**Returns**: the write guard

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Sync/Src/RwLock.rux#L96)

<h2 id="read-guard"><code>ReadGuard&lt;T&gt;</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct ReadGuard<T> {
    // private fields
}
```

A shared hold on an [`RwLock<T>`](/docs/api/sync/rw-lock#rw-lock): the value may be read, and other readers may hold it too.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Sync/Src/RwLock.rux#L32)

**Type parameters**

| Name | Description                   |
| ---- | ----------------------------- |
| `T`  | the type of the guarded value |

**Methods**

<h3 id="read-guard-get"><code>Get</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Get(&self) -> &T
```

The guarded value, borrowed for reading while the guard holds the lock.
The guard stays borrowed while the reference is in use, so it cannot be dropped under it.

**Returns**: a reference to the value

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Sync/Src/RwLock.rux#L135)

<h2 id="write-guard"><code>WriteGuard&lt;T&gt;</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct WriteGuard<T> {
    // private fields
}
```

The exclusive hold on an [`RwLock<T>`](/docs/api/sync/rw-lock#rw-lock): the value may be read and written, and nobody else holds the lock.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Sync/Src/RwLock.rux#L39)

**Type parameters**

| Name | Description                   |
| ---- | ----------------------------- |
| `T`  | the type of the guarded value |

**Methods**

<h3 id="write-guard-get"><code>Get</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Get(&self) -> &T
```

The guarded value, borrowed for reading while the guard holds the lock.
The guard stays borrowed while the reference is in use, so it cannot be dropped under it.

**Returns**: a reference to the value

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Sync/Src/RwLock.rux#L163)

<h3 id="write-guard-get-mutable"><code>GetMutable</code></h3>

```rux
pub func GetMutable(&var self) -> &var T
```

The guarded value, borrowed for writing, which this thread alone may do while the guard holds the lock.
The guard stays borrowed exclusively while the reference is in use.

**Returns**: a writable reference to the value

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Sync/Src/RwLock.rux#L172)
